function.name: telemetry_flowrules_interfaceInfo_get
function.description: Retrieves specified telemetry information for a network interface within a given fabric, node, and pod, filtered by the interface and information types. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

fabricName.description: The name of the fabric to limit the nodes pertaining to the given fabric name.

nodeId.description: The identifier of the node to limit the results pertaining to the given node ID.

podId.description: The identifier of the pod to limit the results pertaining to the given pod ID.

interfaceType.description: The type of the interface to limit the results pertaining to the given interface type.

infoType.description: The type of information to retrieve about the interface.

message.content: I’m happy to help retrieve the interface data for that node. To do so I’ll need the node’s numeric ID (the “nodeId” value). Could you let me know what node ID corresponds to the IP address 23.31.32.1?
message.reasoning: The user asks: "How to get nodes information for fabric test-de, the ip is 23.31.32.1?" They want to get nodes info for fabric test-de. We have a function telemetry_flowrules_interfaceInfo_get which retrieves interface info but not nodes info. There's no function for retrieving nodes info directly. But we can use the interface info function with interfaceType maybe "interfaces" or "status". However they specifically ask for nodes information. We might need to call the function with interfaceType "interfaces" and infoType "interfaces"? That would return interface details for all interfaces on the node. But we don't know nodeId. They gave IP address 23.31.32.1. Maybe we can find nodeId from IP? Not possible without mapping. So we cannot provide nodeId. We could respond explaining that we need nodeId. Or we can ask clarifying question. According to policy, we should ask clarifying question if insufficient info. So we ask: "Could you please provide the node ID for the node with IP 23.31.32.1?"
